explanation: For business meetings, foreign visitors are expected to arrive on time even though a Russian counterpart may themselves show up late without apologizing — your own punctuality still signals seriousness and respect. In casual social settings, a short delay of around 10-15 minutes is usually tolerated without much concern.
local_tip: Arrive on time or a few minutes early for business meetings regardless of whether your Russian counterparts do the same.

also_check.note: Arriving 10-15 minutes late is often acceptable for business meetings, especially in less formal settings.
Arriving even a minute late is considered disrespectful; punctuality is paramount.
Meetings may start later than scheduled, but foreign visitors are still expected to arrive on time.
